title: AKASHA's QuannyB & gooddogthedog Delivered A Thoughtful Single Track, "I/O"
htmlContent:
AKASHA's QuannyB and gooddogthedog have recently released their new single "I/O," a sample-based, indie-influenced, airy trap sound that marks their debut collab. 

The two artists met before the COVID pandemic and found themselves stuck in a small apartment together for a couple of years, creating their first album. 

The track features a beat switch at 1:56, giving listeners a unique musical experience. The song falls under the genre of study beats, jazz-hop, chill-hop, rap, and conscious hip-hop, offering a happy, chill, and epic USA-based vibe. 

With their debut track, AKASHA is ready to take the music industry by storm, showcasing their unique and creative approach to music-making.
